title: Work recommended on the invoice and never said aloud: the customer asks the website
demonstrates: Slot 23 writes up what he is asked for and mentions the rest at pick-up, or not at all. A customer finds 'rear brake pads 3mm, recommend replace' on her invoice at home. The assistant says what 3 mm means in general and hands over. His reply comes at 17:02: 'yeah theyre low. bring it back whenever'. Asked the price, he gives it the next morning, with no time and no step.

timeline.text: Picked up my Tucson at Charlotte Pike yesterday and the invoice says 'rear brake pads 3mm, recommend replace'. Nobody said anything when I paid. Is it safe to drive?

Hello. I'm the assistant for Brennan Auto Care. I can't see your invoice or diagnose a car over chat, but brake pads at 3 mm are close to the end of their life, so it's worth replacing them soon rather than waiting for a noise. I'll pass your question to the Charlotte Pike shop so an advisor can go over it with you. What's your name and the best number to reach you?
Thank you, Monica. Your question is with the team now, and somebody will get back to you as soon as possible.
